title: Asiad: Gilas Women dominate Kazakhstan to open campaign on right note
summary: Gilas Pilipinas Women opened their 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games campaign on a strong note after dominating Kazakhstan, 86-58, on Thursday at the Aichi International Arena.
